scope: Qualified midpoint check. Later checks do not repeat the full initial timing contrast. No engine repair or stable six-percent merge attribution.

source.compiler_guard: Normalized compiler-comment lines compare equal for original A and rebuilt D.

method: Four rounds in each symmetric variant order A,M,D,B,B,D,M,A and B,D,M,A,A,M,D,B. Separate two-query and original six-query checks. Same counter driver and analysis as the primary record.
measurement_contract: Every timed native/TSV answer and normalized plan agrees. Intervals with newly uncounted threads are rejected and retried. All accepted intervals have equal enabled and running time.

build.environment: native build-host toolchain; historical Nix-shell build excluded without timing for compiler mismatch

manifest.store_preparation: A/M/B reuse their existing stores; D shares B. No new loads or load timings. A pre-load trim required unavailable administrator authentication.
